verdicts_or_reports.expected: After switching the note type in Add note (e.g. to "Basic (type in the answer)") and leaving, reopening Add note should show the last chosen note type, since the switch is now stored to the collection straight away.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Reopening Add note always shows "Basic" again. The selected type is not kept. Reproduced twice, with "Basic (and reversed card)" and with "Basic (type in the answer)".
steps: Tap Type spinner, choose 'Basic (type in the answer)'
Press Back to return to the browser
Type spinner shows 'Basic' instead of the chosen type

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Create subdeck dialog (deck list, long-press deck > Create subdeck)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: A whitespace-only subdeck name should keep Create disabled, as the top-level Create deck dialog does, and no deck should be created.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Typing three spaces in the Create subdeck dialog enables Create. Tapping it creates a junk subdeck named 'blank' (Spanish::Nouns::blank). The top-level Create deck dialog keeps Create disabled for the same input.
steps: A new subdeck 'blank' appears under Nouns
Compare: FAB > Create deck, type three spaces: Create stays disabled
